name: MAG 7 Daily
description: MAG 7 Daily follows the seven companies that move the US market — Alphabet (GOOGL/GOOG), Amazon (AMZN), Apple (AAPL), Meta Platforms (META), Microsoft (MSFT), NVIDIA (NVDA) and Tesla (TSLA) — as one desk. Every day: the previous session's closes, the news that moved each company, the strongest counterpoint to the day's story, one thread that runs across several of them, and the dates coming up. Facts and numbers, never picks. Not financial advice.
